rows.text: returns 0 unless byte `+3` of `rcx` ANDed with `0xE0` equals `0x60`; on that path loads qword `+0xB8`, copies its dwords `+0x20`, `+0x24` and `+0x28` to `[rdx]`, `[r8]` and `[r9]`, and returns 1
copies the second float argument `xmm1` into `xmm2` and tail-jumps `0026B2E0`, so the callee receives the same value as its second and third arguments

returns 0.0 when `rcx` is null, its qword `+0xC0` is null or the dword at that pointer is -1; otherwise clamps `edx` to 0 when negative and tail-jumps `003E6150(that dword, 0x9000707)` when the clamped value is 0, else `003E6150(that dword, 0x9000101)`

returns 0.0 when `rcx` is null, its qword `+0xC0` is null or the dword at that pointer is -1; otherwise clamps `edx` to 0 when negative and tail-jumps `003E6150(that dword, 0x9000808)` when the clamped value is 0, else `003E6150(that dword, 0x9000202)`
returns 0.0 when `rcx` is null, its qword `+0xC0` is null or the dword at that pointer is -1; otherwise tail-jumps `003E6150(low word of that dword, 0x9001D1E)`

when byte `+8` of `r8` is non-zero, word `+0xA` of `r8` selects: 1 calls `002EBC90(rdx, 0, 1)` and `002E28E0(rdx, 002E97C0(dword r8+4))`, 3 calls `002EBC90(rdx, 3, 1)` and `002E3110(rdx, 4, 0, 002E97C0(dword r8+4), 0)`, each followed by `002EAC90(rdx)`, and any other value does neither; every path then tail-jumps `0025B470(rdx, 00265950(rdx))`
calls `0026A1A0(rdx, 0)` and `0034BE50(rcx, rdx, r8, r9)`, passes `002E9B10(rdx)` as the float to `0026AC70(rdx, value)`, calls `002EC510(1, rdx, qword [r8])` and tail-jumps `002690D0(rdx)`
calls `0026A1A0(rdx, 1)` and `0034BE50(rcx, rdx, r8, r9)`, passes `002E9B10(rdx)` as the float to `0026AC70(rdx, value)`, calls `002EC510(1, rdx, qword [r8])` and tail-jumps `002690D0(rdx)`

loads qword `+0x400` of `rcx` and returns the float at `+0x144` of the address formed by adding its word `+2` to the pointer's low 32 bits and sign-extending the sum; returns 1.0 (`01CEBBA8`) when the qword is null or that 32-bit sum is zero
returns the zero-extended word `+4` of the block that qword `+0x400` of `rcx` points to, with no null check
returns 0 when qword `+0x400` of `rcx` is null; otherwise tail-jumps `004FE2F0(that qword, 0x62060A2D)`

loads qword `+0x400` of `rcx` and, when it is non-null and its word `+0x12` is non-zero, returns the float at `+0xA8` of the pointer's low 32 bits plus that word, sign-extended; returns 0.10472 (`00D117BC`) when the qword is null, the word is zero or the 32-bit sum is zero

loads qword `+0x400` of `rcx` and, when it is non-null and its word `+0x12` is non-zero, returns the dword at `+0xA4` of the pointer's low 32 bits plus that word, sign-extended; returns 0 when the qword is null, the word is zero or the 32-bit sum is zero
returns at once when dword `+0x300` of `rcx` is 0; otherwise adds that dword to `003AB7F0(0020E600(dword +0x2FC))` and, when the 32-bit sum is non-zero, tail-jumps `0051D310(sum)`, else returns

returns at once when dword `+0x300` of `rcx` is 0; otherwise adds that dword to `003AB7F0(0020E600(dword +0x2FC))` and, when the 32-bit sum is non-zero, tail-jumps `0051DB60(sum)` if `edx` is non-zero or calls `00519720(sum)` if `edx` is zero; a zero sum returns without either call

loads qword `+0x400` of `rcx` and, when it is non-null and its word `+0x10` is non-zero, reads the word at the pointer's low 32 bits plus that word (sign-extended) and returns it times `0x1D0` plus `0x10`; returns 0 when the qword is null or the word is zero
returns zero-extended word `+0x30` of `rcx` when its dword `+4` equals 2, else dword `+0xC`

walks the `0x740`-stride records under qword `022C6F28` starting at the index in dword `+0x48800` of that base and following each record's signed word `+4` until -1, calling `003E66D0(record)` (and reloading the base) for each record whose byte `+0x290` has bit `0x2` clear; returns at once when the start index is -1
calls `002EBC90(rdx, 0, 1)`, `002E28E0(rdx, qword [r8+8])` and `002EAC90(rdx)`, then tail-jumps `002EB330(rdx, 0x1001)`

calls `001FBD80(2)` and `0039D3F0()`; resolves word `+8` of `rcx` (unless `0xFFFF`) to the `0x740`-stride record under qword `022C6F28`, nulled when its dword `+0x284` is 0; returns without further work when byte `+6` is 0 or bit `0x2` of byte `+7` OR dword `02CA8428` is set; otherwise copies `0x150` bytes of `02AEC180` to the stack, patches in a qword built from the bytes `01F2B349`-`01F2B34D` ORed with `0x2005C00400002A00`, vectors from `02AEDD30`-`02AEDEA0` and lane 2 of `02AEDD60` plus 30000.0 (`009146FC`), and submits `00540C70(packet, 0x15, 0)`; then for each of word `+0` records of stride `0x1D0` from `rcx` plus word `+2` it copies `0x1E0` bytes of `02AEC2D0`, splices the record's first `0x1A0` bytes at packet `+0x10`, multiplies packet floats `+0x3C` and `+0x5C` by `003E5770(resolved record)`, `+0x20` by record float `+0x1C0` and `+0x24` by header float `+0xC` widened to double, and submits `00540C70(packet, 0x1E, 0)`; finally calls `001FBE50()`

stores word 1 at `+6` of `rcx`, then for each of word `+0` records of stride `0x1D0` starting at the 32-bit sum of `rcx` and word `+2` stores 1.0 (`0x3F800000`) at `+0x14`, 0 at `+0` and `+0x10`, 1 at `+0x1C4`, and calls `00861EC0(record+0xA0, 0, 0x100)`

notes: 0051CDE0: the header float +0xC multiplier for packet +0x24 passes through a call to 00861F5C when 001EDDA0() returns 0 (xmm0 holds the widened float at that call); the row assumes xmm0 is unchanged by it, so OPUS should confirm 00861F5C leaves xmm0 as is or reword that clause. Its early-out on byte +6 / the flag test jumps past 001FBE50, so the 001FBD80(2) call is unpaired on that path. 003E4700/003E5C90/003E5EA0/003E6D10/0051DB60 add a section-offset word to the low 32 bits of a pointer (add eax, edx / add ebx, ecx) and sign- or zero-extend; the rows say so rather than 'block + word'.
